sn16.12:1.3: This is a stock series of propositions by non-Buddhists, asked as a teaching method.
sn16.12:1.4: An awakened one, whether the Buddha or anyone else, exists after death, for example in an eternal state of Nirvana.
sn16.12:1.7: A sage ceases to exist at the time of death. This assumes there is an enduring “self” that is done away with.
sn16.12:1.10: For example, their body does not exist but their mind does.
sn16.12:1.13: A sage is in a subtle state that cannot be characterized in terms of existence or non-existence.
